metadata.description: Joey Farbstein's free skills for Claude Code: raise-the-bar and hatch.

plugins.name: raise-the-bar
plugins.description: The AI can't grade its own work. A fresh critic says SHIP or NOT YET and names the one thing to fix. Loops up to 3 rounds.

plugins.name: hatch
plugins.description: Turn a fuzzy problem, half-baked idea, or risky decision into a shipped, defended result. Frame, diverge, judge, red-team, build, ship-gate.
